title: Sigmoid activation
summary: The TensorFlow.js sigmoid maps each independent input value through 1/(1+exp(−x)); the CUDA teaching kernel assigns one thread to each element.
limitations: Fixed fixture contains five float32 values; tensor broadcasting, alternate dtypes, gradients, and backend dispatch are omitted.
The code is a CUDA-C teaching equivalent of the pointwise formula, not TensorFlow.js source transpilation.

stages.title: Independent pointwise mapping
stages.summary: Each valid thread loads one input and computes its sigmoid without communicating with other threads.
stages.insight: The function is elementwise, so one output thread needs no reduction or synchronization.
